cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Carry This with Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take half Mum's care-home forms. We are both her children; I can't also be the entire admissions department.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'll put you as main contact. You understand these.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Main contact takes the calls; it doesn't mean 'knows everything.' Put your number down. I'll help with anything you can't answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll be ringing you every time they ask something.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not while they're still talking. Write the question down, finish the call, then ring me. We'll work it out together.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 invokes shared parentage to divide care work. B2's proposed contact choice lets A3 correct a mistaken definition of the role; A5 supervises how B will seek help instead of taking the task back.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 allocates A the calls on grounds of expertise. A3 separates receiving calls from knowing answers. B4 predicts reliance on A, so A5 offers a controlled way to share questions.

relationship.evidence: A1 identifies siblings under family pressure. B2's deference is understandable and B4's anxiety changes A's support offer; B need not be implausibly incompetent.

heightening.evidence: B4 threatens to return each question to A immediately; A5 retains the new contact arrangement while specifying how the siblings will handle uncertainty together.

specificity.evidence: A1's care-home forms and B2's contact field locate the work. A3 names the actual burden of answering calls, making the dispute playable without reading an unseen form.

brevityWit.evidence: A1's admissions-department complaint expresses overload. A5 ends on shared work rather than adding a detachable family-duty moral.

coach2.inferred: B is hesitant, not necessarily incapable. A assumes supervisory competence over the paperwork.
coach2.missing: No actual care-home rule or clinical decision is needed to follow the siblings' allocation.
coach2.firstDefect: No mandatory-gate failure found. A5 anticipates interruption from B4's immediate dependence rather than alleging a past error.

reservation: Professional strain is expressed through managing B's participation, not repeated jargon. Its intensity is quieter than the wedding-cake seed; fidelity is 4, not the former 5.
